source.citation: J. Janisch, G. Raabe, J. Koehler, Vapor-Liquid Equilibria and Saturated Liquid Densities in Binary Mixtures of Nitrogen, Methane, and Ethane, J. Chem. Eng. Data 52 (2007) 1897-1903
source.access: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive, free access to the data of J. Chem. Eng. Data
source.tables: ThermoML file: 2nd PureOrMixtureData block (vapour or sublimation pressure, kPa, of methane + nitrogen as a function of liquid mole fraction of nitrogen and temperature) and 4th block (mole fraction of nitrogen in the gas phase, same states). Expanded uncertainties (95 %) from nCombExpandUncertValue.
source.transcription: Read from the ThermoML XML with a web-reading tool (two independent readings agreed on every value); the reviewer should compare each row with the XML.

notes: x_N2 and y_N2 are mole fractions of nitrogen. Values copied as given in the ThermoML file. The point at 179.976 K (y close to x) lies near the mixture critical point.
